strand.name: Setup Codon
strand.promptText: Create a directory called 'notes' and write a file called 'setup.txt' with the text 'Setup complete'.

strand.name: Iterative Work Loop
strand.description: Loop for iterative work that may be interrupted

codons.name: Write Iteration File
codons.promptText: Write a file to <%PROJECT_DIR%>/notes/iteration_<TIMESTAMP>.txt with content: 'Iteration number X' (where X is the iteration number). Make sure each file is unique.

codons.name: Review Iteration
codons.promptText: Review the iteration file you just created and write a brief comment about it to <%PROJECT_DIR%>/notes/review_<TIMESTAMP>.txt.

strand.name: Final Codon
strand.promptText: Create a file <%PROJECT_DIR%>/notes/final.txt with the content 'Final codon reached'.
